translations.text: The vision of Obadiah. Thus says the Lord God concerning Idumea: You have heard a report from the Lord, and he has sent out a siege against the nations: "Arise, and let us rise up against her for battle."
Behold, I have made you few in number among the nations; you are greatly despised.
The pride of your heart has lifted you up, you who dwell in the clefts of the rock. He sets his dwelling on high and says in his heart, "Who will bring me down to the ground?"
Even if you rise up high like an eagle, or set your nests among the stars, from there I will cast you down, says the Lord.

If thieves had come in to you, or robbers by night, where would you have been cast away? Would they not have stolen plenty for themselves? And if grape-gatherers had come in to you, would they not have left a shoot for grafting?
How Esau has been searched out, and his hidden things seized!

They have driven you out as far as the border. All the men of your covenant have risen up against you, and the men at peace with you have overpowered you, and they have laid a snare beneath you. There is no understanding in him.
On that day I will destroy the wise out of Idumea, and understanding from the mountain of Esau, says the Lord.
And your mighty warriors, the men of Teman, will tremble, so that people may be wiped out from the mountain of Esau,
because of the slaughter and the wrong done to your brother Jacob. Shame will cover you, and you will be wiped out forever.

From the day you stood opposite him as an enemy, on that day when foreigners carried his people away captive, and strangers entered his gates and cast lots over Jerusalem, you too were like one of them.
Do not forget the day of your brother, that day of the foreigners. Do not take satisfaction over the sons of Judah on the day of their destruction, and do not speak proudly on the day of affliction.

Do not enter the gates of the people on the day of their suffering, and do not look on their gathering on the day of their slaughter, and do not take your fill of their wealth on the day of their destruction.
Do not stand at their exits to kill those of them who escape, and do not hold back their fugitives on the day of affliction.
For the day of the Lord is near upon all the nations. As you have done, so it will be done to you; your recompense will be returned upon your own head.
For just as you drank on my holy mountain, so all the nations will drink wine. They will drink and fall, and they will become as though they had never been.
But on Mount Zion there will be salvation, and it will be holy, and the house of Jacob will take possession of those who had taken possession of them.

The house of Jacob will be a fire, and the house of Joseph a flame of fire, but the house of Esau will be reeds. They will blaze up against them as against reeds and devour them, and the house of Esau will not be without fire, for the Lord has spoken.

Those who are in the Negev will possess the mountain of Esau, and those who are in the Shephelah will possess the foreigners. They will possess the mountain of Ephraim, the plain of Samaria, Benjamin and Gilead.
This is the beginning of the exile of the sons of Israel: the land of the Canaanites as far as Zarephath, and the inheritance of Israel as far as Ephratha. They will possess the cities of Geth [?].
Those who have been rescued will come up from Mount Zion to take vengeance on the mountain of Esau, and the kingdom will be the Lord's.
